# X18a-default-model-turn-override: A Review with no model of its own on a profile whose configured model the account is not offered: thread/start names gpt-5.6-sol, the pass reads the whole list (model/list{includeHidden:true}, no gpt-5.6-sol), and turn/start carries the account's default (gpt-6-luna). Codex runs it: no refusal, the turn completes; no frame names the turn's model, so its first usage total confirms it.
# Recorded with codex-cli 0.160.1 (read-only feature switches: features.apps, features.plugins, features.hooks = false) (a ChatGPT login, the Windows sandbox ready); the published fixture is synthesized from that recording (scripts/synthesize-fixtures.mjs), which stays private.
# The frames are what the adapter sends after X09h's thread/start (default-model.ts); its replay takes X01a's list as the probe's facts (pass.json "probe").
# responders.mjs answers every server request as the adapter does (recipes/dim-factory-responder.mjs).
# --allow-user-codex-home only when <CODEX_HOME> is your own ~/.codex.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --codex-app-server --bin "<codex.exe>" --codex-home "<CODEX_HOME>" --allow-user-codex-home --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures-private/codex/app-server/X18a-default-model-turn-override --id X18a --slug default-model-turn-override --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --timeout 900000 --stdin tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X18a-default-model-turn-override/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X18a-default-model-turn-override/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X18a-default-model-turn-override/responders.mjs
